name: harness-embedding-provider
description: AgentPM Harness starter that hosts a local embedding provider for the published AgentPM docs Knowledge package.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: Generated project name. Generation-time only; do not use for API keys, tokens, passwords, or runtime secrets.

variables.name: workspace_label
variables.description: Human-readable label shown in the generated README, Harness config, and terminal output.

variables.name: default_user_scope
variables.description: Default user scope supplied by the SDK client when it launches Harness.

variables.name: openai_model
variables.description: Default OpenAI model identifier used by agentpm.harness.json. Set credentials at runtime, not as a template variable.

entrypoints.label: Run one Knowledge-backed prompt
entrypoints.command: pnpm dev -- "Use the AgentPM docs Knowledge package to explain how Harness SDK-hosted providers work."
